title: Final Mass and Velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The final rest mass and velocity of the composite particle must be correctly calculated as 12.1 g and 0.168c.

title: Conservation Laws
description: Important Criteria: The application of conservation of energy and momentum principles must be clearly demonstrated.

title: Final Velocity for m2
description: Essential Criteria: The final velocity of m2 must be correctly determined as 0.9c.

title: Composite Velocity Calculations
description: Important Criteria: The calculations for the velocities in parts (b) and (c) must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Alternative Velocities
description: Optional Criteria: The alternative velocities for m2 in part (c) should be identified as 0.185c and 0.151c.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any unit mistakes or inconsistencies in mass or velocity must be penalized.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the equations must be identified and penalized.
